label: PE

notes.grounding: Every checked claim matches the script: options --verbose/--json/--quality/--file/--help, 'Overall Completion: N%' in folder mode and 'Completion:' in --file mode, final exit 0 at line 587, exit 1 for errors, bc guard before the work, trailer comment after exit 0, printf %.0f rounding. The T001 grep was run and prints exactly four lines (309, 425, 545, 587).
notes.requirements: Testable and complete: exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N, byte-identical stdout in five forms, exit 1 with stderr for missing, non-integer or out-of-range values, plus --help. Gaps: no behaviour defined for --file pointed at a missing file (percentage falls back to 0) or for a nonexistent folder with the option set, and REQ-001's wording is garbled.
notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause and the parity and boundary checks would catch a wrong gate. Several checks are weak: T003 and T005 are greps that prove presence, not behaviour. T005 counts with grep -c, so it cannot show one assignment per function. T004 does not check stderr. T007 does not verify the exit-code line or the trailer. T008 and T009 leave <args> and the script path unfilled.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option at Level 1 with justified out-of-scope items. Template boilerplate in plan.md section 2 ('Tests passing (if applicable)') is mild filler. No unfilled tokens.
notes.consistency: Ids, path, exit codes and boundary method agree across the three docs. Small drifts: spec.md says the exit-code trailer gets an exit 3 entry, but plan.md's components and T007 only mention an exit-code line in show_help, which has no exit-code section today. T005 introduces REPORTED_PERCENTAGE, which plan.md never names.
notes.clarity: A developer could build it from the packet. Open details: where the exit-code line goes in --help, the relative base of FIXTURE=scratch/fixture, and how to handle a missing $2 under set -u, which spec.md requires to exit 1 but never says how.
